**Pull request #3245 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# PR #3245: Patch: one set of button roles (primary, secondary, danger, text) across the menus and the board

Closes #3219

Each button now takes one of four roles, defined in one new sheet, `apps/web/src/buttons.css`, and drawn the same on every screen, in the tavern or not, on a menu or on the board. Every web test, typecheck, eslint and e2e specs 46 and 47 pass.

## What changed

- **`buttons.css`** (new; `index.css` imports it sixth) holds the four roles and the tokens they use:
  - `button-primary`: the gold `--primary-face`, unlit when disabled.
  - `button-secondary`: works on a `<button>` and an `<a>` alike. A `<button>` with no role now looks like this.
  - `button-danger`: new, using a new `--danger` token (`--pal-red-600`, the same red as `--opponent`).
  - `link-button`: a gold text action.

  The `--primary-*` tokens moved here from `index.css`, along with the result panel's first-action rule from `animations.css` and End turn's green ready state (B15) from `highlights.css`. Each role weighs one class. The generic rules that would outweigh a role skip it through a weightless `:where(:not())`: the shell hover, the tavern's prose-link rule and the landing panels' wood.
- **No second copy of a skin:**
  - `tavern.css`, `index.css`, `game-banner.css`, `lobby.css`, `account.css`, `auth.css`, `practice.css`, `sandbox.css`, `deckbuilder.css`, `workshop.css`, `notices.css`, `prompt.css` and `board.css` keep only layout for these controls. The tavern only sets its buttons' size now.
  - The implicit wood skin on a bare `<button>` is gone; the secondary skin is what such a button gets.
  - `grep primary-face` over the stylesheets finds only `buttons.css`.
- **Role classes on the controls:**
  - Danger: Concede, Delete account, Leave game, Leave fight, the match's Leave, the duos Concede, and deck/trio Delete.
  - `ws-action--primary` and `ws-action--danger` are gone. Every one-off class the issue lists now names a role.
- **Tests:**
  - New `buttons.test.ts` with five tests. One renders each role on `<button>` and `<a>` in four hosts (`.tavern`, `.tavern.deckbuilder`, `.app-shell`, `.board`) and checks they draw the same background and colour.
  - Others check that no other sheet restates a role's or a one-off's skin, and that only `buttons.css` names `--primary-face`.
  - The last freezes the button skins that remain in `UNROLED`, each with its reason.
  - `buttons.css` now counts as a board sheet in the palette, surfaces, typescale and motion tests.
- **Colour counts:** `UNMIGRATED` only went down: tavern 113→70, practice 58→41, game-banner 30→8, lobby 53→50, duos 14→13, workshop 16→14, account 5→3. `index.css` stays at 0.
- **Other tests and docs:** class assertions added in the ConfirmConcede, practice, account and FightScreen tests; top-bar and Rematch tests updated; one Board snapshot updated. The paragraph in `apps/web/README.md` added.

## How I tested it

- I checked that the new tests really catch the old styling: a temporary copy of `buttons.test.ts` (since deleted) was run against `main`'s stylesheets, and all five tests fail. The cross-screen test shows the tavern drawing a raw-hex gold gradient where other screens draw blue; the restating test lists 46 rules.
- `vitest run` on the 11 files the plan names, plus `Board.test.tsx` and `landing.test.tsx`: 13 files, 343 tests passed.
- Full `vitest run --project web`: 9823 passed, 9 failed.
  - One real failure: the Board snapshot. Its only change is the two new role classes (End turn, hero power), so I updated it.
  - Eight timeouts in `wording`, `writing` and `patches/diff`, hit while the server's release build was using every core. Re-run alone they pass (78/78).
- `pnpm typecheck` and `pnpm exec eslint apps/web` are clean.
- e2e against `build:e2e` + `vite preview` + `E2E=1` server: spec 46 passed 54/54, spec 47 passed 30/30.
- In a headless browser:
  - `/login`: gold Sign in, the secondary Show, gold text links.
  - The hotseat board: live End turn is gold, and the enemy-turn End turn keeps its sunken look.
  - The concede dialog: gold Keep playing, red Concede.

I did not run the Rust checks: no Rust, spec or ruling is touched.

## Decisions the plan did not settle

- **End turn in the opponent's turn:** I moved its sunken housing colours into `buttons.css`, next to B15's green, instead of deleting them as the plan said. Deleting would have turned the most-seen disabled control on the board from sunken to raised.
- **landing.css's quests and news panels:** their wood rule now skips role buttons. It was painting the quests' Replace and Keep it `link-button`s wood, which breaks "one look everywhere". Their bare buttons keep the wood.
- **Deck builder:** the tavern's primary `:active` rule skips `.deckbuilder`, like the size rules, so the workshop's new gold Import presses 1 px as before, not 3 px.
- **Smaller changes:** `.app-shell a.button-danger` joined the anchor layout rule. I updated old "wood button" comments in `tutorial.css`, `auth.css`, `top-bar.css`, `stats.css`, `tavern.css` and `PatchNotes.tsx`.

## Worth a second look

- **Intended look changes:**
  - The flat blue primaries outside the tavern (`/replays`, the decks shell) and the workshop's blue primary turn gold.
  - The tavern's wood buttons turn flat.
  - db-chips get lighter.
  - The tavern's disabled gold is drawn unlit at the shared 0.45 opacity.
  - The duos Concede shows its armed state with a red outline.
- **Armed End turn:** B25's armed edge (`.control[data-confirm="armed"]`, the `--selected` colour) now shows. The old primary rule out-weighed it.
- **Left as the plan decided:**
  - Some `link-button`s still draw their own look (in patches.css and stats.css); they are left for a follow-up issue.
  - Pressed toggles are left to the tabs/segmented issue.
  - `.db-actions button` still counts in `UNROLED`, but no component renders it any more.
```
